requirement_vague: Verify article updated timestamp changes on update but created timestamp remains unchanged
requirement_precise: Create a user (username: 'timestampuser1', email: 'timestampuser1@test.com', password: 'pass123'). Create an article with title 'Timestamp Test Article'. Extract slug, created, and updated timestamps from response. Wait briefly, then PUT /api/articles/{slug} with updated title 'Updated Timestamp Article'. GET /api/articles/{slug}. Verify the 'created' timestamp is unchanged from original. Verify the 'updated' timestamp is different (newer) than the original. This tests the @BeforeUpdate hook that updates the timestamp.

implementation.code_reference:
ts = now_iso()
article = Article(..., created_at=ts, updated_at=ts, ...)
...
article.updated_at = now_iso()
implementation.reasoning: On article creation, both created_at and updated_at are initialized to the same timestamp. On article update, only updated_at is reassigned while created_at is never modified, and GET /api/articles/{slug} returns these values as created/updated (and createdAt/updatedAt), so the created timestamp remains unchanged and the updated timestamp changes after an update.
